description: This source file defines MKLDNN-based binary operations (addition and multiplication) in PyTorch, with stub implementations when MKLDNN support is disabled and full implementations using ideep when enabled.

methods.name: Tensor & mkldnn_add_out(const Tensor & self,const Tensor & other,const Scalar & alpha,Tensor & result)
methods.description: Performs MKLDNN addition of two tensors with scaling factor alpha and writes result to output tensor.

methods.name: Tensor mkldnn_add(const Tensor & self,const Tensor & other,const Scalar & alpha)
methods.description: Performs MKLDNN addition of two tensors with scaling factor alpha, returning new tensor.

methods.name: Tensor & mkldnn_add_(Tensor & self,const Tensor & other,const Scalar & alpha)
methods.description: Performs in-place MKLDNN addition of two tensors with scaling factor alpha.

methods.name: Tensor & mkldnn_mul_out(const Tensor & self,const Tensor & other,Tensor & result)
methods.description: Performs MKLDNN multiplication of two tensors and writes the result to the output tensor.

methods.name: Tensor mkldnn_mul(const Tensor & self,const Tensor & other)
methods.description: Performs MKLDNN multiplication of two tensors, returning a new tensor.

methods.name: Tensor & mkldnn_mul_(Tensor & self,const Tensor & other)
methods.description: Performs in-place MKLDNN multiplication of two tensors.
